captions: {city} sees measurable rain on about {total} days a year, most often in {peak}. It is repeated wetting rather than annual totals that finds the weak point — flashing, grading, window seals and a gutter that cannot keep up.

Rain falls on roughly {total} days a year in {city}, {SS}, peaking in {peak} and easing to {low_value} in {low}. A building envelope is tested on every one of those days, and the failures show up in the wettest stretch.
{city} records measurable rain on about {total} days a year. Frequency matters more than volume for water intrusion — material that never fully dries between wettings is where rot and mould start.
